## 2. Core Models (`app/models.py`)

```python
from datetime import datetime
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import UUID
import uuid

db = SQLAlchemy()

class User(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'users'
    id = db.Column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    username = db.Column(db.String(80), unique=True, nullable=False)
    password_hash = db.Column(db.String(128), nullable=False)
    role = db.Column(db.String(20), nullable=False)  # admin, dispatcher, driver
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Vehicle(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'vehicles'
    id = db.Column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    license_plate = db.Column(db.String(20), unique=True, nullable=False)
    make = db.Column(db.String(50))
    model = db.Column(db.String(50))
    year = db.Column(db.Integer)
    capacity_tons = db.Column(db.Float)
    status = db.Column(db.String(20), default='available')  # available, in_use, maintenance
    last_location_lat = db.Column(db.Float)
    last_location_lon = db.Column(db.Float)
    last_update = db.Column(db.DateTime)

class Driver(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'drivers'
    id = db.Column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    name = db.Column(db.String(120), nullable=False)
    license_number = db.Column(db.String(30), unique=True, nullable=False)
    phone = db.Column(db.String(20))
    status = db.Column(db.String(20), default='active')  # active, inactive
    vehicle_id = db.Column(UUID(as_uuid=True), db.ForeignKey('vehicles.id'))
    vehicle = db.relationship('Vehicle', backref='driver')

class Order(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'orders'
    id = db.Column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    pickup_address = db.Column(db.String(200))
    delivery_address = db.Column(db.String(200))
    pickup_lat = db.Column(db.Float)
    pickup_lon = db.Column(db.Float)
    delivery_lat = db.Column(db.Float)
    delivery_lon = db.Column(db.Float)
    weight_tons = db.Column(db.Float)
    status = db.Column(db.String(20), default='pending')  # pending, assigned, in_transit, delivered
    assigned_driver_id = db.Column(UUID(as_uuid=True), db.ForeignKey('drivers.id'))
    assigned_driver = db.relationship('Driver', backref='orders')
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
```

## 3. Flask App Factory (`app/__init__.py`)

```python
from flask import Flask
from .config import DevelopmentConfig
from .models import db
from .routes import auth_bp, fleet_bp, dispatch_bp, reports_bp

def create_app(config_class=DevelopmentConfig):
    app = Flask(__name__)
    app.config.from_object(config_class)

    db.init_app(app)

    # Register blueprints
    app.register_blueprint(auth_bp, url_prefix='/api/auth')
    app.register_blueprint(fleet_bp, url_prefix='/api/fleet')
    app.register_blueprint(dispatch_bp, url_prefix='/api/dispatch')
    app.register_blueprint(reports_bp, url_prefix='/api/reports')

    return app
```

## 4. Sample Routes

### Auth (`app/routes/auth.py`)

```python
from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify
from werkzeug.security import generate_password_hash, check_password_hash
from ..models import db, User
from ..utils.jwt import encode_jwt, decode_jwt

auth_bp = Blueprint('auth', __name__)

@auth_bp.route('/register', methods=['POST'])
def register():
    data = request.json
    if User.query.filter_by(username=data['username']).first():
        return jsonify({'msg': 'Username already exists'}), 400
    user = User(
        username=data['username'],
        password_hash=generate_password_hash(data['password']),
        role=data.get('role', 'dispatcher')
    )
    db.session.add(user)
    db.session.commit()
    return jsonify({'msg': 'User created'}), 201

@auth_bp.route('/login', methods=['POST'])
def login():
    data = request.json
    user = User.query.filter_by(username=data['username']).first()
    if not user or not check_password_hash(user.password_hash, data['password']):
        return jsonify({'msg': 'Invalid credentials'}), 401
    token = encode_jwt(user.id, user.role)
    return jsonify({'access_token': token})
```

### Fleet (`app/routes/fleet.py`)

```python
from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify
from ..models import db, Vehicle, Driver
from ..utils.jwt import jwt_required

fleet_bp = Blueprint('fleet', __name__)

@fleet_bp.route('/vehicles', methods=['GET'])
@jwt_required
def list_vehicles():
    vehicles = Vehicle.query.all()
    return jsonify([{
        'id': v.id,
        'license_plate': v.license_plate,
        'status': v.status,
        'last_location': {'lat': v.last_location_lat, 'lon': v.last_location_lon}
    } for v in vehicles])

@fleet_bp.route('/vehicles', methods=['POST'])
@jwt_required
def add_vehicle():
    data = request.json
    vehicle = Vehicle(
        license_plate=data['license_plate'],
        make=data.get('make'),
        model=data.get('model'),
        year=data.get('year'),
        capacity_tons=data.get('capacity_tons')
    )
    db.session.add(vehicle)
    db.session.commit()
    return jsonify({'msg': 'Vehicle added', 'id': str(vehicle.id)}), 201
```

### Dispatch (`app/routes/dispatch.py`)

```python
from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify
from ..models import db, Order, Driver, Vehicle
from ..services.routing import optimize_route
from ..utils.jwt import jwt_required

dispatch_bp = Blueprint('dispatch', __name__)

@dispatch_bp.route('/orders', methods=['POST'])
@jwt_required
def create_order():
    data = request.json
    order = Order(
        pickup_address=data['pickup_address'],
        delivery_address=data['delivery_address'],
        pickup_lat=data['pickup_lat'],
        pickup_lon=data['pickup_lon'],
        delivery_lat=data['delivery_lat'],
        delivery_lon=data['delivery_lon'],
        weight_tons=data['weight_tons']
    )
    db.session.add(order)
    db.session.commit()
    return jsonify({'msg': 'Order created', 'id': str(order.id)}), 201

@dispatch_bp.route('/orders/<uuid:order_id>/assign', methods=['POST'])
@jwt_required
def assign_order(order_id):
    order = Order.query.get_or_404(order_id)
    # Simple assignment logic: pick first available driver
    driver = Driver.query.filter_by(status='active', vehicle_id=None).first()
    if not driver:
        return jsonify({'msg': 'No available driver'}), 404
    order.assigned_driver = driver
    order.status = 'assigned'
    db.session.commit()
    return jsonify({'msg': 'Order assigned', 'driver_id': str(driver.id)})
```

from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify
from ..models import db, Order, Driver
from ..utils.jwt import jwt_required

reports_bp = Blueprint('reports', __name__)

@reports_bp.route('/orders', methods=['GET'])
@jwt_required
def get_orders_report():
    status = request.args.get('status')
    query = Order.query
    if status:
        query = query.filter_by(status=status)
    orders = query.all()
    return jsonify([{
        'id': o.id,
        'status': o.status,
        'created_at': o.created_at.isoformat(),
        'driver': o.assigned_driver.name if o.assigned_driver else None
    } for o in orders])

## 5. Routing Service (`app/services/routing.py`)

```python
import requests
from urllib.parse import urlencode

BASE_URL = "http://router.project-osrm.org"

def optimize_route(locations):
    """
    locations: list of (lat, lon) tuples
    Returns: ordered list of indices representing optimal route
    """
    coords = ";".join(f"{lon},{lat}" for lat, lon in locations)
    params = {
        'overview': 'false',
        'steps': 'false',
        'annotations': 'false',
        'geometries': 'geojson',
        'source': 'first',
        'destination': 'last',
        'roundtrip': 'false',
        'service': 'route',
        'profile': 'driving',
        'alternatives': 'false',
        'continue_straight': 'true',
        'waypoints': ",".join(str(i) for i in range(len(locations)))
    }
    url = f"{BASE_URL}/trip/v1/driving/{coords}?{urlencode(params)}"
    resp = requests.get(url, timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()
    if data['code'] != 'Ok':
        raise Exception(f"Routing error: {data['message']}")
    return data['trips'][0]['waypoint_indices']
```

> **Tip:** For production, consider running your own OSRM/GraphHopper instance or using a commercial API like Mapbox Directions.

## 7. JWT Utilities (`app/utils/jwt.py`)

```python
import jwt
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from flask import request, jsonify
from functools import wraps

SECRET_KEY = "YOUR_SECRET_KEY"  # Use env var in prod
ALGORITHM = "HS256"

def encode_jwt(user_id, role):
    payload = {
        "sub": str(user_id),
        "role": role,
        "exp": datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(hours=8)
    }
    return jwt.encode(payload, SECRET_KEY, algorithm=ALGORITHM)

def decode_jwt(token):
    return jwt.decode(token, SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])

def jwt_required(fn):
    @wraps(fn)
    def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
        auth_header = request.headers.get("Authorization", "")
        if not auth_header.startswith("Bearer "):
            return jsonify({"msg": "Missing token"}), 401
        token = auth_header.split(" ")[1]
        try:
            payload = decode_jwt(token)
            request.user = payload
        except jwt.ExpiredSignatureError:
            return jsonify({"msg": "Token expired"}), 401
        except jwt.InvalidTokenError:
            return jsonify({"msg": "Invalid token"}), 401
        return fn(*args, **kwargs)
    return wrapper
```
